rationale: DB/checker execution crosses beyond candidate capture
stop_condition: Implementation must not begin without a separate prompt.

rationale: DB execution needs a local engine and safe configuration
stop_condition: Future MVP should start postgres only.

rationale: DB credentials must not be committed
validation_method: Check env/local ignored config only credentials_in_repo_or_output
stop_condition: No credentials in repo or audit outputs.

rationale: User outputs must remain under runs/user
stop_condition: Reject absolute paths parent traversal reports results cases.

rationale: Execution must fail closed and not hang
validation_method: Config review and timeout tests no_timeout_or_unbounded_execution

rationale: DDL/load setup must be isolated and cleanup-safe
validation_method: Design review and MVP smoke schema_missing_or_cleanup_unsafe

rationale: Checker semantics must come from case package config

stop_condition: Fail closed rather than raw text compare.

rationale: Expected comparison roles must be explicit
stop_condition: Fail closed rather than infer source/candidate roles.

rationale: User runs are not curated release outputs
User runs must not modify canonical packages
stop_condition: Stop if case package files change.

rationale: Execution does not change membership or registry facts
validation_method: git status case_sets inventory check case_sets_or_inventory_changed

rationale: Local execution does not alter paper scope
validation_method: git diff protected file check denominator_or_paper_result_changed

rationale: Future MVP is local diagnostics only
User outputs are not paper retained evidence
validation_method: Ledger boundary and path check retained_evidence_input_not_false

stop_condition: Reports may summarize one local run only.

rationale: Default CI must not require local DB
stop_condition: DB smoke should be manual opt-in if later added.

rationale: Outputs must not expose secrets or private paths
validation_method: Static scan of local artifacts unsafe_secret_or_private_path
stop_condition: Fail closed and keep artifacts local.
